import tiles = "./tiles.qui"

class Split(int pair, int[][] sets)

int[][] ordered_sets(int[][] blocks)
    result := blocks
    for: 1 <= i < int(#result)
        j := i
        while j > 0
            left := result[j - 1][0] * 2 + (if result[j - 1][0] == result[j - 1][2] then 0 else 1)
            right := result[j][0] * 2 + (if result[j][0] == result[j][2] then 0 else 1)
            if left <= right
                break
            temporary := result[j - 1]
            result[j - 1] = result[j]
            result[j] = temporary
            j -= 1
    return result

void visit_sets(int[] remaining, int pair_kind, int needed, int[][] chosen, Split[] &found)
    first := -1
    for: i < 34
        if remaining[i] > 0
            first = i
            break
    if int(#chosen) == needed
        if first < 0
            ordered := ordered_sets(chosen)
            duplicate := false
            for prior := found[]
                if prior.pair == pair_kind and prior.sets == ordered
                    duplicate = true
            if not duplicate
                found = found.append(Split(pair_kind, ordered))
        return
    if first < 0
        return
    if remaining[first] >= 3
        next := remaining
        next[first] -= 3
        visit_sets(next, pair_kind, needed, chosen.append([first, first, first]), &found)
    if first < 27 and first % 9 <= 6 and remaining[first + 1] > 0 and remaining[first + 2] > 0
        next := remaining
        next[first] -= 1
        next[first + 1] -= 1
        next[first + 2] -= 1
        visit_sets(next, pair_kind, needed, chosen.append([first, first + 1, first + 2]), &found)

Split[] standard_splits(int[] counts, meld_count := 0)
    total := 0
    for amount := counts[]
        total += amount
    needed := 4 - meld_count
    Split[] result := []
    if total != needed * 3 + 2
        return result
    for: pair_kind < 34
        if counts[pair_kind] >= 2
            remaining := counts
            remaining[pair_kind] -= 2
            visit_sets(remaining, pair_kind, needed, [], &result)
    return result

bool seven_pairs(int[] counts)
    pairs := 0
    for amount := counts[]
        if amount == 2
            pairs += 1
        elif amount != 0
            return false
    return pairs == 7

bool thirteen_orphans(int[] counts)
    total := 0
    for: kind < 34
        total += counts[kind]
        if tiles.is_yaochuu(kind)
            if counts[kind] == 0
                return false
        elif counts[kind] != 0
            return false
    return total == 14

bool winning_form(int[] counts, meld_count := 0)
    return #standard_splits(counts, meld_count) > 0 or (meld_count == 0 and (seven_pairs(counts) or thirteen_orphans(counts)))

int[] waiting_kinds(int[] hand_counts, int[] meld_counts, int meld_count)
    int[] result := []
    for: kind < 34
        if hand_counts[kind] + meld_counts[kind] < 4
            concealed := hand_counts
            concealed[kind] += 1
            if winning_form(concealed, meld_count)
                result = result.append(kind)
    return result

string wait_shape(string form, int[] block, int winning_kind, int[] hand_counts)
    if form == "chiitoitsu"
        return "tanki"
    if form == "kokushi"
        for kind := tiles.orphans()[]
            if hand_counts[kind] != 1
                return "single"
        return "thirteen"
    if #block == 2
        return "tanki"
    if block[0] == block[2]
        return "shanpon"
    first := block[0]
    if winning_kind == first + 1
        return "kanchan"
    if (first % 9 == 0 and winning_kind == first + 2) or (first % 9 == 6 and winning_kind == first)
        return "penchan"
    return "ryanmen"

import tiles = "./tiles.qui"
import decomposition = "./decomposition.qui"
import yaku = "./yaku.qui"
import scoring = "./scoring.qui"
import shanten = "./shanten.qui"

class Record(string label, string[] values)
class Rule(string name, bool open_tanyao, bool red_fives, bool double_yakuman, bool kazoe_yakuman, bool kiriage, int honba)
class Meld(string kind, tiles.Parsed parsed, int[] block)

Record[] read_records(string filename)
    string content := string.from_utf8(file.read_bin("input/" + filename))
    rows := content.split(NL)
    Record[] result := []
    for: row_index < int(#rows) - 1
        fields := rows[row_index].split(" ")
        string[] values := []
        for: 1 <= i < int(#fields)
            values = values.append(fields[i].split("=")[1])
        result = result.append(Record(fields[0], values))
    return result

Rule[] read_rules()
    Rule[] result := []
    for record := read_records("rules.txt")[]
        fields := record.values
        result = result.append(Rule(record.label, fields[0] == "yes", fields[1] == "yes", fields[2] == "yes", fields[3] == "yes", fields[4] == "yes", int(fields[5])))
    return result

Rule find_rule(Rule[] rules, string name)
    for rule := rules[]
        if rule.name == name
            return rule
    return rules[0]

Meld[] parse_melds(string text)
    Meld[] result := []
    if text == "-"
        return result
    for piece := text.split(",")[]
        parsed := tiles.parse_tiles(piece[1:])
        int[] kinds := [for item := parsed.items[] then item.kind].sorted()
        result = result.append(Meld(piece[0], parsed, kinds))
    return result

distinct<string> parse_flags(string text)
    distinct<string> result
    if text != "-"
        for flag := text.split(",")[]
            .result.add(flag)
    return result

class Situation(Record record, Rule rule)
    tiles.Parsed hand := tiles.parse_tiles(record.values[1])
    Meld[] melds := parse_melds(record.values[2])
    tiles.Parsed win := tiles.parse_tiles(record.values[3])
    string by := record.values[4]
    string seat := record.values[5]
    string discarder := record.values[6]
    string round_wind := record.values[7]
    distinct<string> flags := parse_flags(record.values[8])
    tiles.Parsed dora := tiles.parse_tiles(record.values[9])
    tiles.Parsed ura := tiles.parse_tiles(record.values[10], true)
    tiles.Parsed discards := tiles.parse_tiles(record.values[11], true)
    honba := int(record.values[12])
    sticks := int(record.values[13])
    int seat_tile := tiles.wind_kind(seat)
    int round_tile := tiles.wind_kind(round_wind)
    closed := true
    kan_count := 0
    tiles.Tile[] meld_tiles := []
    for meld := melds[]
        if meld.kind != "A"
            closed = false
        if meld.kind == "K" or meld.kind == "A"
            kan_count += 1
        meld_tiles = meld_tiles.concat(meld.parsed.items)
    bool riichi := flags.has("riichi") or flags.has("double_riichi")
    int winning_kind := if #win.items == 1 then win.items[0].kind else -1
    int[] hand_counts := tiles.count_tiles(hand.items)
    int[] concealed_counts := tiles.count_tiles(hand.items.concat(win.items))
    int[] meld_counts := tiles.count_tiles(meld_tiles)
    tiles.Tile[] all_tiles := hand.items.concat(win.items).concat(meld_tiles)
    int[] all_counts := tiles.count_tiles(all_tiles)

class WaitingHand(Record record, Rule rule)
    tiles.Parsed hand := tiles.parse_tiles(record.values[1])
    string seat := record.values[2]
    string round_wind := record.values[3]
    bool riichi := record.values[4] == "yes"
    tiles.Parsed dora := tiles.parse_tiles(record.values[5])
    tiles.Parsed discards := tiles.parse_tiles(record.values[6], true)
    tiles.Parsed visible := tiles.parse_tiles(record.values[7], true)
    int[] counts := tiles.count_tiles(hand.items)
    int[] known_counts := tiles.count_tiles(hand.items.concat(dora.items).concat(discards.items).concat(visible.items))

class Candidate(string form_type, int pair_kind, int[][] sets, int[] winning_block, string form, string wait)
    yaku.Award[] ordinary := []
    yaku.Award[] yakuman := []
    scoring.FuItem[] fu_items := []
    multiplier := 0
    han := 0
    fu := 0
    fu_total := 0
    base := 0
    dora := 0
    aka := 0
    ura := 0
    category := "none"

bool contains_kind(int[] values, int wanted)
    for item := values[]
        if item == wanted
            return true
    return false

bool meld_valid(Meld meld)
    size := int(#meld.block)
    if meld.kind == "C"
        return size == 3 and meld.block[0] < 27 and meld.block[0] % 9 <= 6 and meld.block[1] == meld.block[0] + 1 and meld.block[2] == meld.block[0] + 2
    if meld.kind != "P" and meld.kind != "K" and meld.kind != "A"
        return false
    if size != (if meld.kind == "P" then 3 else 4)
        return false
    for item := meld.block[]
        if item != meld.block[0]
            return false
    return true

string copies_error(tiles.Tile[] items, Rule rule)
    reds := [0, 0, 0]
    for item := items[]
        if item.red
            reds[item.kind / 9] += 1
    if not rule.red_fives and reds[0] + reds[1] + reds[2] > 0
        return "red five not allowed"
    counts := tiles.count_tiles(items)
    for: kind < 34
        if counts[kind] >= 5
            return "too many copies of " + tiles.kind_name(kind)
    suits := "mps"
    for: suit < 3
        if reds[suit] >= 2
            return "too many copies of 0" + suits[suit]
    return ""

string situation_error(Situation situation)
    if not situation.hand.valid or not situation.win.valid or not situation.dora.valid or not situation.ura.valid or not situation.discards.valid or #situation.win.items != 1
        return "bad tile notation"
    for meld := situation.melds[]
        if not meld.parsed.valid
            return "bad tile notation"
    if #situation.melds >= 5
        return "bad meld"
    for meld := situation.melds[]
        if not meld_valid(meld)
            return "bad meld"
    if int(#situation.hand.items) != 13 - 3 * int(#situation.melds)
        return "wrong tile count"
    problem := copies_error(situation.all_tiles.concat(situation.dora.items).concat(situation.ura.items).concat(situation.discards.items), situation.rule)
    if problem != ""
        return problem
    if (situation.by == "tsumo" and situation.discarder != "-") or (situation.by == "ron" and (situation.discarder == "-" or situation.discarder == situation.seat))
        return "invalid discarder"
    flags := situation.flags
    valid_flags := [
        situation.closed,
        situation.closed and not flags.has("riichi"),
        situation.riichi and not flags.has("rinshan"),
        situation.by == "tsumo" and not flags.has("rinshan"),
        situation.by == "ron" and not flags.has("chankan"),
        situation.by == "tsumo" and situation.kan_count >= 1,
        situation.by == "ron",
        situation.seat == "E" and situation.by == "tsumo" and #situation.melds == 0 and flags.size() == 1,
        situation.seat != "E" and situation.by == "tsumo" and #situation.melds == 0 and flags.size() == 1,
    ]
    ordered_flags := yaku.flag_names()
    for: i < int(#ordered_flags)
        if flags.has(ordered_flags[i]) and not valid_flags[i]
            return "invalid flag " + ordered_flags[i]
    if int(#situation.dora.items) != 1 + situation.kan_count
        return "invalid dora indicators"
    if (situation.riichi and #situation.ura.items != #situation.dora.items) or (not situation.riichi and #situation.ura.items > 0)
        return "invalid ura indicators"
    if situation.riichi and situation.sticks == 0
        return "invalid sticks"
    if not decomposition.winning_form(situation.concealed_counts, int(#situation.melds))
        return "not a winning hand"
    return ""

string waiting_error(WaitingHand hand)
    if not hand.hand.valid or not hand.dora.valid or not hand.discards.valid or not hand.visible.valid
        return "bad tile notation"
    if #hand.hand.items != 13
        return "wrong tile count"
    return copies_error(hand.hand.items.concat(hand.dora.items).concat(hand.discards.items).concat(hand.visible.items), hand.rule)

Candidate[] make_candidates(Situation situation)
    Candidate[] result := []
    winning := situation.winning_kind
    counts := situation.concealed_counts
    for split := decomposition.standard_splits(counts, int(#situation.melds))[]
        int[][] blocks := [[split.pair, split.pair]]
        blocks = blocks.concat(split.sets)
        int[][] choices := []
        for block := blocks[]
            duplicate := false
            for previous := choices[]
                if previous == block
                    duplicate = true
            if contains_kind(block, winning) and not duplicate
                choices = choices.append(block)
        for chosen := choices[]
            parts := ["standard"]
            marked := false
            for block := blocks[]
                notation := tiles.block_name(block)
                if block == chosen and not marked
                    notation += "*"
                    marked = true
                parts = parts.append(notation)
            for meld := situation.melds[]
                parts = parts.append(meld.kind + tiles.block_name(meld.block))
            result = result.append(Candidate("standard", split.pair, split.sets, chosen, parts.join(" "), decomposition.wait_shape("standard", chosen, winning, situation.hand_counts)))
    if #situation.melds == 0 and decomposition.seven_pairs(counts)
        parts := ["chiitoitsu"]
        for: kind < 34
            if counts[kind] > 0
                parts = parts.append(tiles.block_name([kind, kind]) + (if kind == winning then "*" else ""))
        result = result.append(Candidate("chiitoitsu", -1, [], [], parts.join(" "), "tanki"))
    if #situation.melds == 0 and decomposition.thirteen_orphans(counts)
        parts := ["kokushi"]
        for kind := tiles.orphans()[]
            block := array(nat(counts[kind]), fill = kind)
            parts = parts.append(tiles.block_name(block) + (if kind == winning then "*" else ""))
        result = result.append(Candidate("kokushi", -1, [], [], parts.join(" "), decomposition.wait_shape("kokushi", [], winning, situation.hand_counts)))
    map<string, Candidate> by_form
    for candidate := result[]
        .by_form.set(candidate.form, candidate)
    Candidate[] ordered := []
    for form := by_form.keys().sorted()[]
        match by_form.get(form)
            Candidate candidate
                ordered = ordered.append(candidate)
            none
                void
    return ordered

class Facts(scoring.Triplet[] triplets, int[] sequences, int[] concealed_sequences, int concealed_count, int kans, int dragons, int winds, bool[] triplet_kinds)

Facts block_facts(Situation situation, Candidate candidate)
    scoring.Triplet[] triplets := []
    int[] sequences := []
    int[] concealed_sequences := []
    for block := candidate.sets[]
        if block[0] == block[2]
            triplets = triplets.append(scoring.Triplet(block, situation.by == "tsumo" or block != candidate.winning_block, false))
        else
            sequences = sequences.append(block[0])
            concealed_sequences = concealed_sequences.append(block[0])
    for meld := situation.melds[]
        if meld.kind == "C"
            sequences = sequences.append(meld.block[0])
        else
            triplets = triplets.append(scoring.Triplet(meld.block, meld.kind == "A", meld.kind == "K" or meld.kind == "A"))
    concealed_count := 0
    kans := 0
    triplet_kinds := array(34, fill = false)
    for triplet := triplets[]
        if triplet.concealed
            concealed_count += 1
        if triplet.kan
            kans += 1
        triplet_kinds[triplet.kinds[0]] = true
    dragons := 0
    winds := 0
    for: 27 <= kind < 34
        if triplet_kinds[kind]
            if kind >= 31
                dragons += 1
            else
                winds += 1
    return Facts(triplets, sequences, concealed_sequences, concealed_count, kans, dragons, winds, triplet_kinds)

distinct<string> yakuman_names(Situation situation, Candidate candidate, Facts facts)
    distinct<string> names
    for flag := ["tenhou", "chiihou"][]
        if situation.flags.has(flag)
            .names.add(flag)
    honors := true
    terminals := true
    green := true
    single_suit := -1
    same_suit := true
    for: kind < 34
        if situation.all_counts[kind] == 0
            continue
        honors = honors and tiles.is_honor(kind)
        terminals = terminals and tiles.is_terminal(kind)
        green = green and tiles.is_green(kind)
        if single_suit < 0
            single_suit = kind / 9
        elif single_suit != kind / 9
            same_suit = false
    if honors
        .names.add("tsuuiisou")
    if terminals
        .names.add("chinroutou")
    if green
        .names.add("ryuuiisou")
    if #situation.melds == 0 and same_suit and single_suit < 3
        start := single_suit * 9
        nine_gates := situation.all_counts[start] >= 3 and situation.all_counts[start + 8] >= 3
        for: 1 <= offset <= 7
            nine_gates = nine_gates and situation.all_counts[start + offset] >= 1
        if nine_gates
            expected := [3, 1, 1, 1, 1, 1, 1, 1, 3]
            pure := situation.hand_counts[start:<start + 9] == expected
            .names.add(if pure then "junsei_chuuren" else "chuuren")
    if candidate.form_type == "kokushi"
        .names.add(if candidate.wait == "thirteen" then "kokushi_13" else "kokushi")
    if candidate.form_type == "standard"
        if facts.concealed_count == 4
            .names.add(if candidate.wait == "tanki" then "suuankou_tanki" else "suuankou")
        if facts.dragons == 3
            .names.add("daisangen")
        if facts.winds == 4
            .names.add("daisuushii")
        if facts.winds == 3 and candidate.pair_kind >= 27 and candidate.pair_kind <= 30
            .names.add("shousuushii")
        if facts.kans == 4
            .names.add("suukantsu")
    return names

distinct<string> ordinary_names(Situation situation, Candidate candidate, Facts facts)
    distinct<string> names
    flags := yaku.flag_names()
    for: i < 7
        if situation.flags.has(flags[i])
            .names.add(flags[i])
    if situation.closed and situation.by == "tsumo"
        .names.add("menzen_tsumo")
    all_simple := true
    all_yaochuu := true
    honors := false
    distinct<int> number_suits
    for: kind < 34
        if situation.all_counts[kind] == 0
            continue
        all_simple = all_simple and not tiles.is_yaochuu(kind)
        all_yaochuu = all_yaochuu and tiles.is_yaochuu(kind)
        if tiles.is_honor(kind)
            honors = true
        else
            .number_suits.add(kind / 9)
    if all_simple and (situation.closed or situation.rule.open_tanyao)
        .names.add("tanyao")
    if all_yaochuu
        .names.add("honroutou")
    if number_suits.size() == 1
        .names.add(if honors then "honitsu" else "chinitsu")
    if candidate.form_type == "chiitoitsu"
        .names.add("chiitoitsu")
    if candidate.form_type != "standard"
        return names
    pair_kind := candidate.pair_kind
    value_pair := pair_kind >= 31 or pair_kind == situation.seat_tile or pair_kind == situation.round_tile
    if situation.closed and #situation.melds == 0 and #facts.concealed_sequences == 4 and not value_pair and candidate.wait == "ryanmen"
        .names.add("pinfu")
    repeated := array(27, fill = 0)
    for start := facts.concealed_sequences[]
        repeated[start] += 1
    sequence_pairs := 0
    duplicate := false
    for amount := repeated[]
        sequence_pairs += amount / 2
        if amount >= 2
            duplicate = true
    if situation.closed and #facts.concealed_sequences == 4 and sequence_pairs == 2
        .names.add("ryanpeikou")
    elif situation.closed and duplicate
        .names.add("iipeikou")
    value_kinds := [31, 32, 33, situation.seat_tile, situation.round_tile]
    value_names := ["haku", "hatsu", "chun", "jikaze", "bakaze"]
    for: i < 5
        if facts.triplet_kinds[value_kinds[i]]
            .names.add(value_names[i])
    if #facts.triplets == 4
        .names.add("toitoi")
    if facts.concealed_count == 3
        .names.add("sanankou")
    sequence_kinds := array(27, fill = false)
    for start := facts.sequences[]
        sequence_kinds[start] = true
    for: start < 7
        if sequence_kinds[start] and sequence_kinds[start + 9] and sequence_kinds[start + 18]
            .names.add("sanshoku_doujun")
    for: number < 9
        if facts.triplet_kinds[number] and facts.triplet_kinds[number + 9] and facts.triplet_kinds[number + 18]
            .names.add("sanshoku_doukou")
    for: suit < 3
        if sequence_kinds[suit * 9] and sequence_kinds[suit * 9 + 3] and sequence_kinds[suit * 9 + 6]
            .names.add("ittsu")
    int[][] blocks := [[pair_kind, pair_kind]]
    blocks = blocks.concat(candidate.sets)
    for meld := situation.melds[]
        blocks = blocks.append(meld.block)
    outside := #facts.sequences > 0
    for block := blocks[]
        includes := false
        for kind := block[]
            includes = includes or tiles.is_yaochuu(kind)
        outside = outside and includes
    if outside
        .names.add(if honors then "chanta" else "junchan")
    if facts.kans == 3
        .names.add("sankantsu")
    if facts.dragons == 2 and pair_kind >= 31
        .names.add("shousangen")
    return names

Candidate evaluate_candidate(Situation situation, Candidate original)
    candidate := original
    facts := block_facts(situation, candidate)
    names := yakuman_names(situation, candidate, facts)
    candidate.yakuman = yaku.yakuman_awards(names, situation.rule.double_yakuman)
    if #candidate.yakuman > 0
        for award := candidate.yakuman[]
            candidate.multiplier += award.amount
        candidate.base = 8000 * candidate.multiplier
        candidate.category = "yakuman"
        return candidate
    names = ordinary_names(situation, candidate, facts)
    candidate.ordinary = yaku.ordinary_awards(names, situation.closed)
    for indicator := situation.dora.items[]
        candidate.dora += situation.all_counts[tiles.next_indicator(indicator.kind)]
    for indicator := situation.ura.items[]
        candidate.ura += situation.all_counts[tiles.next_indicator(indicator.kind)]
    for item := situation.all_tiles[]
        if item.red
            candidate.aka += 1
    fu_result := scoring.fu_breakdown(candidate.form_type, candidate.pair_kind, facts.triplets, candidate.wait, situation.closed, situation.by, situation.seat_tile, situation.round_tile, names.has("pinfu"))
    candidate.fu_items = fu_result.items
    candidate.fu_total = fu_result.total
    candidate.fu = fu_result.rounded
    if #candidate.ordinary > 0
        candidate.han = candidate.dora + candidate.aka + candidate.ura
        for award := candidate.ordinary[]
            candidate.han += award.amount
        limit_result := scoring.score_limit(candidate.han, candidate.fu, situation.rule.kazoe_yakuman, situation.rule.kiriage)
        candidate.category = limit_result.category
        candidate.base = limit_result.base
    return candidate

Candidate[] evaluate_all(Situation situation)
    return [for candidate := make_candidates(situation)[] then evaluate_candidate(situation, candidate)]

int best_index(Candidate[] candidates)
    result := -1
    for: i < int(#candidates)
        current := candidates[i]
        if current.base <= 0
            continue
        better := result < 0
        if result >= 0
            prior := candidates[result]
            if current.base != prior.base
                better = current.base > prior.base
            elif (#current.yakuman > 0) != (#prior.yakuman > 0)
                better = #current.yakuman > 0
            elif #current.yakuman == 0 and current.han != prior.han
                better = current.han > prior.han
            elif #current.yakuman == 0 and current.fu != prior.fu
                better = current.fu > prior.fu
        if better
            result = i
    return result

string award_names(yaku.Award[] awards, string separator)
    return [for award := awards[] then award.name].join(separator)

string candidate_line(Candidate candidate)
    string evaluation
    if #candidate.yakuman > 0
        evaluation = "yakuman {candidate.multiplier} base {candidate.base} yaku " + award_names(candidate.yakuman, ",")
    elif #candidate.ordinary == 0
        evaluation = "no_yaku"
    else
        evaluation = "han {candidate.han} fu {candidate.fu} base {candidate.base} yaku " + award_names(candidate.ordinary, ",")
    return "CANDIDATE {candidate.form} = {candidate.wait} {evaluation}"

string signed_points(int amount)
    return (if amount > 0 then "+" else "") + string(amount)

class WinReport(string[] lines, int points)

WinReport winning_lines(Situation situation, Candidate candidate)
    lines := ["FORM " + candidate.form, "WAIT " + candidate.wait]
    if #candidate.yakuman > 0
        for award := candidate.yakuman[]
            lines = lines.append("YAKUMAN {award.name} {award.amount}")
        lines = lines.append("SCORE yakuman {candidate.multiplier} base {candidate.base}")
    else
        for award := candidate.ordinary[]
            lines = lines.append("YAKU {award.name} {award.amount}")
        lines = lines.append("DORA dora {candidate.dora} aka {candidate.aka} ura {candidate.ura}")
        for item := candidate.fu_items[]
            lines = lines.append("FU {item.name} {item.amount}")
        lines = lines.concat(["FU total {candidate.fu_total} {candidate.fu}", "SCORE han {candidate.han} fu {candidate.fu} limit {candidate.category} base {candidate.base}"])
    payment := scoring.payment_points(candidate.base, situation.seat == "E", situation.by)
    if situation.by == "ron"
        lines = lines.append("PAY ron {payment.ron}")
    elif situation.seat == "E"
        lines = lines.append("PAY tsumo all {payment.nondealer}")
    else
        lines = lines.append("PAY tsumo dealer {payment.dealer} nondealer {payment.nondealer}")
    honba := situation.honba * situation.rule.honba
    sticks := situation.sticks * 1000
    gain := payment.total + honba + sticks
    lines = lines.concat(["BONUS honba {honba} sticks {sticks}", "TOTAL points {payment.total} gain {gain}"])
    delta := [0, 0, 0, 0]
    if situation.by == "ron"
        delta[tiles.wind_kind(situation.discarder) - 27] = -payment.ron - honba
    else
        for: i < 4
            if i != situation.seat_tile - 27
                amount := if i == 0 then payment.dealer else payment.nondealer
                delta[i] = -amount - honba / 3
    delta[situation.seat_tile - 27] = gain
    lines = lines.append("DELTA E " + signed_points(delta[0]) + " S " + signed_points(delta[1]) + " W " + signed_points(delta[2]) + " N " + signed_points(delta[3]))
    return WinReport(lines, payment.total)

Situation hypothetical(WaitingHand hand, int winning, string method)
    fields := hand.record.values
    discarder := if method == "tsumo" then "-" elif hand.seat == "E" then "S" else "E"
    record := Record(hand.record.label, [fields[0], fields[1], "-", tiles.kind_name(winning), method, hand.seat, discarder, hand.round_wind, if hand.riichi then "riichi" else "-", fields[5], "-", fields[6], "0", "0"])
    return Situation(record, hand.rule)

int text_count(map<string, int> counts, string key)
    match counts.get(key)
        int amount
            return amount
        none
            return 0

int integer_count(map<int, int> counts, int key)
    match counts.get(key)
        int amount
            return amount
        none
            return 0

void add_text(map<string, int> &counts, string key, amount := 1)
    .counts.set(key, text_count(counts, key) + amount)

void add_integer(map<int, int> &counts, int key)
    .counts.set(key, integer_count(counts, key) + 1)

class Statistics(Rule[] rules)
    totals := map<string, int>()
    wins := map<string, int>()
    waits := map<string, int>()
    hans := map<int, int>()
    fus := map<int, int>()
    limits := map<string, int>()
    awards := map<string, int>()
    rule_hands := map<string, int>()
    rule_wins := map<string, int>()
    rule_points := map<string, int>()
    maximum := 0
    maximum_hand := "-"
    summary := ["hand,han,fu,points,yaku"]

void record_win(Statistics &stats, Situation situation, Candidate candidate, int points)
    add_text(&stats.totals, "wins")
    add_text(&stats.totals, "points", points)
    add_text(&stats.rule_wins, situation.rule.name)
    add_text(&stats.rule_points, situation.rule.name, points)
    group := (if situation.seat == "E" then "dealer_" else "nondealer_") + situation.by
    add_text(&stats.wins, group)
    add_text(&stats.waits, candidate.wait)
    add_text(&stats.limits, candidate.category)
    awards := if #candidate.yakuman > 0 then candidate.yakuman else candidate.ordinary
    for award := awards[]
        add_text(&stats.awards, award.name)
    string han
    string fu
    if #candidate.yakuman > 0
        han = "Y{candidate.multiplier}"
        fu = "-"
    else
        han = string(candidate.han)
        fu = string(candidate.fu)
        add_integer(&stats.hans, candidate.han)
        add_integer(&stats.fus, candidate.fu)
    stats.summary = stats.summary.append("{situation.record.label},{han},{fu},{points}," + award_names(awards, ";"))
    if points > stats.maximum
        stats.maximum = points
        stats.maximum_hand = situation.record.label

string[] score_statistics(Statistics stats, int hands)
    lines := ["STATS hands {hands} wins {text_count(stats.totals, "wins")} furiten {text_count(stats.totals, "furiten")} no_yaku {text_count(stats.totals, "no_yaku")} errors {text_count(stats.totals, "errors")}"]
    groups := ["dealer_ron", "dealer_tsumo", "nondealer_ron", "nondealer_tsumo"]
    lines = lines.append("WINS " + [for group := groups[] then "{group} {text_count(stats.wins, group)}"].join(" "))
    shapes := ["ryanmen", "kanchan", "penchan", "shanpon", "tanki", "single", "thirteen"]
    lines = lines.append("WAIT_COUNT " + [for shape := shapes[] then "{shape} {text_count(stats.waits, shape)}"].join(" "))
    for han := stats.hans.keys().sorted()[]
        lines = lines.append("HAN_COUNT {han} {integer_count(stats.hans, han)}")
    for fu := stats.fus.keys().sorted()[]
        lines = lines.append("FU_COUNT {fu} {integer_count(stats.fus, fu)}")
    for category := yaku.categories()[]
        lines = lines.append("LIMIT {category} {text_count(stats.limits, category)}")
    string[] ordered_names := [for entry := yaku.ordinary_table()[] then entry.name].concat([for entry := yaku.yakuman_table()[] then entry.name])
    for name := ordered_names[]
        amount := text_count(stats.awards, name)
        if amount > 0
            lines = lines.append("YAKU_COUNT {name} {amount}")
    lines = lines.append("POINTS total {text_count(stats.totals, "points")} max {stats.maximum} hand {stats.maximum_hand}")
    for rule := stats.rules[]
        lines = lines.append("RULE {rule.name} hands {text_count(stats.rule_hands, rule.name)} wins {text_count(stats.rule_wins, rule.name)} points {text_count(stats.rule_points, rule.name)}")
    return lines

bool discarded_wait(tiles.Tile[] discards, int[] waiting)
    for item := discards[]
        if contains_kind(waiting, item.kind)
            return true
    return false

string[] score_hands(Record[] records, Rule[] rules, Statistics &stats)
    string[] lines := []
    for record := records[]
        situation := Situation(record, find_rule(rules, record.values[0]))
        add_text(&stats.rule_hands, situation.rule.name)
        lines = lines.append("HAND " + record.label)
        problem := situation_error(situation)
        if problem != ""
            add_text(&stats.totals, "errors")
            lines = lines.append("ERROR " + problem)
            stats.summary = stats.summary.append(record.label + ",-,-,0,ERROR")
            continue
        waiting := decomposition.waiting_kinds(situation.hand_counts, situation.meld_counts, int(#situation.melds))
        lines = lines.append("WAITS " + [for kind := waiting[] then tiles.kind_name(kind)].join(" "))
        evaluated := evaluate_all(situation)
        lines = lines.concat([for candidate := evaluated[] then candidate_line(candidate)])
        if situation.by == "ron" and discarded_wait(situation.discards.items, waiting)
            add_text(&stats.totals, "furiten")
            lines = lines.append("RESULT furiten")
            stats.summary = stats.summary.append(record.label + ",-,-,0,FURITEN")
            continue
        best := best_index(evaluated)
        if best < 0
            add_text(&stats.totals, "no_yaku")
            lines = lines.append("RESULT no_yaku")
            stats.summary = stats.summary.append(record.label + ",-,-,0,NO_YAKU")
            continue
        report := winning_lines(situation, evaluated[best])
        lines = lines.concat(report.lines)
        record_win(&stats, situation, evaluated[best], report.points)
    return lines.concat(score_statistics(stats, int(#records)))

int minimum_number(int[] values)
    result := values[0]
    for item := values[]
        if item < result
            result = item
    return result

class Acceptance(int kind, int remaining)

Acceptance[] acceptance_tiles(WaitingHand hand, int current, map<string, int[][]> &cache)
    Acceptance[] result := []
    for: kind < 34
        if hand.counts[kind] >= 4
            continue
        counts := hand.counts
        counts[kind] += 1
        if minimum_number(shanten.shanten_numbers(counts, &cache)) < current
            result = result.append(Acceptance(kind, 4 - hand.known_counts[kind]))
    return result

string[] tenpai_lines(WaitingHand hand, Acceptance[] waiting, bool furiten)
    string[] lines := []
    best_kinds := [-1, -1]
    best_points := [0, 0]
    methods := ["ron", "tsumo"]
    for accepted := waiting[]
        results := ["no_yaku", "no_yaku"]
        for: method_index < 2
            if method_index == 0 and furiten
                results[method_index] = "furiten"
                continue
            situation := hypothetical(hand, accepted.kind, methods[method_index])
            evaluated := evaluate_all(situation)
            best := best_index(evaluated)
            if best < 0
                continue
            payment := scoring.payment_points(evaluated[best].base, hand.seat == "E", methods[method_index])
            results[method_index] = string(payment.total)
            if best_kinds[method_index] < 0 or payment.total > best_points[method_index]
                best_kinds[method_index] = accepted.kind
                best_points[method_index] = payment.total
        lines = lines.append("WAIT {tiles.kind_name(accepted.kind)} left {accepted.remaining} ron {results[0]} tsumo {results[1]}")
    choices := ["none", "none"]
    for: i < 2
        if best_kinds[i] >= 0
            choices[i] = "{tiles.kind_name(best_kinds[i])} {best_points[i]}"
    return lines.append("BEST ron {choices[0]} tsumo {choices[1]}")

string[] analyze_waits(Record[] records, Rule[] rules)
    string[] lines := []
    errors := 0
    tenpai := 0
    furiten_count := 0
    distribution := array(7, fill = 0)
    map<string, int[][]> cache
    for record := records[]
        hand := WaitingHand(record, find_rule(rules, record.values[0]))
        lines = lines.append("HAND " + record.label)
        problem := waiting_error(hand)
        if problem != ""
            errors += 1
            lines = lines.append("ERROR " + problem)
            continue
        numbers := shanten.shanten_numbers(hand.counts, &cache)
        current := minimum_number(numbers)
        distribution[current] += 1
        lines = lines.append("SHANTEN standard {numbers[0]} chiitoitsu {numbers[1]} kokushi {numbers[2]}")
        accepted := acceptance_tiles(hand, current, &cache)
        total := 0
        for item := accepted[]
            total += item.remaining
        if current != 0
            text := "ACCEPT kinds {#accepted} tiles {total}"
            for item := accepted[]
                text += " {tiles.kind_name(item.kind)}:{item.remaining}"
            lines = lines.append(text)
            continue
        tenpai += 1
        waiting := [for item := accepted[] then item.kind]
        furiten := discarded_wait(hand.discards.items, waiting)
        if furiten
            furiten_count += 1
        lines = lines.append("TENPAI kinds {#accepted} tiles {total} furiten " + (if furiten then "yes" else "no"))
        lines = lines.concat(tenpai_lines(hand, accepted, furiten))
    lines = lines.append("STATS hands {#records} errors {errors} tenpai {tenpai} furiten {furiten_count}")
    for: number < 7
        lines = lines.append("SHANTEN_COUNT {number} {distribution[number]}")
    return lines

void run_program()
    bool directory_exists := file.is_directory("output")
    if not directory_exists
        file.mkdir("output")
    rules := read_rules()
    stats := Statistics(rules)
    score_lines := score_hands(read_records("hands.txt"), rules, &stats)
    wait_lines := analyze_waits(read_records("waits.txt"), rules)
    writer1 := file.write("output/scores.txt")
    .writer1(score_lines.join(NL) + NL)
    writer2 := file.write("output/waits.txt")
    .writer2(wait_lines.join(NL) + NL)
    writer3 := file.write("output/summary.csv")
    .writer3(stats.summary.join(NL) + NL)

run_program()

FuItem triplet_points(Triplet triplet)
    string kind
    int amount
    if triplet.kan
        kind = if triplet.concealed then "closed_kan" else "open_kan"
        amount = if triplet.concealed then 16 else 8
    else
        kind = if triplet.concealed then "closed_triplet" else "open_triplet"
        amount = if triplet.concealed then 4 else 2
    if tiles.is_yaochuu(triplet.kinds[0])
        amount *= 2
    return FuItem(kind + " " + tiles.block_name(triplet.kinds), amount)

Fu fu_breakdown(string form, int pair_kind, Triplet[] triplets, string wait, bool closed, string method, int seat, int round_wind, bool pinfu)
    if form == "chiitoitsu"
        return Fu([FuItem("chiitoitsu", 25)], 25, 25)
    items := [FuItem("base", 20)]
    if closed and method == "ron"
        items = items.append(FuItem("closed_ron", 10))
    if method == "tsumo" and not pinfu
        items = items.append(FuItem("tsumo", 2))
    pair_value := 0
    if pair_kind >= 31
        pair_value += 2
    if pair_kind == seat
        pair_value += 2
    if pair_kind == round_wind
        pair_value += 2
    if pair_value > 0
        items = items.append(FuItem("pair " + tiles.block_name([pair_kind, pair_kind]), pair_value))
    for triplet := triplets[]
        items = items.append(triplet_points(triplet))
    if wait == "kanchan" or wait == "penchan" or wait == "tanki"
        items = items.append(FuItem("wait " + wait, 2))
    total := 0
    for item := items[]
        total += item.amount
    if not closed and total == 20
        items = items.append(FuItem("open_pinfu", 10))
        total += 10
    return Fu(items, total, (total + 9) / 10 * 10)

Limit score_limit(int han, int fu, bool kazoe, bool kiriage)
    if han >= 13 and kazoe
        return Limit("kazoe_yakuman", 8000)
    if han >= 11
        return Limit("sanbaiman", 6000)
    if han >= 8
        return Limit("baiman", 4000)
    if han >= 6
        return Limit("haneman", 3000)
    base := fu * 2 ^ (han + 2)
    if han == 5 or base >= 2000 or (kiriage and base == 1920)
        return Limit("mangan", 2000)
    return Limit("none", base)

int round_hundred(int amount)
    return (amount + 99) / 100 * 100

Payments payment_points(int base, bool dealer_win, string method)
    if method == "ron"
        amount := round_hundred(base * (if dealer_win then 6 else 4))
        return Payments(amount, 0, 0, amount)
    if dealer_win
        amount := round_hundred(base * 2)
        return Payments(0, 0, amount, amount * 3)
    dealer := round_hundred(base * 2)
    nondealer := round_hundred(base)
    return Payments(0, dealer, nondealer, dealer + 2 * nondealer)

import tiles = "./tiles.qui"

string state_key(int[] counts, bool suited)
    return (if suited then "s" else "z") + [for amount := counts[] then string(amount)].join(",")

int[][] block_patterns(int[] counts, bool suited, map<string, int[][]> &cache)
    key := state_key(counts, suited)
    match cache.get(key)
        int[][] cached
            return cached
        none
            void
    first := -1
    for: i < int(#counts)
        if counts[i] > 0
            first = i
            break
    if first < 0
        return [[0, 0, 0]]
    int[][] removed := [[first]]
    int[][] extras := [[0, 0, 0]]
    if counts[first] >= 3
        removed = removed.append([first, first, first])
        extras = extras.append([1, 0, 0])
    if counts[first] >= 2
        removed = removed.concat([[first, first], [first, first]])
        extras = extras.concat([[0, 1, 0], [0, 0, 1]])
    if suited
        if first <= 6 and counts[first + 1] > 0 and counts[first + 2] > 0
            removed = removed.append([first, first + 1, first + 2])
            extras = extras.append([1, 0, 0])
        for: 1 <= difference <= 2
            other := first + difference
            if other < 9 and counts[other] > 0
                removed = removed.append([first, other])
                extras = extras.append([0, 1, 0])
    best := array(10, fill = -1)
    for: choice < int(#removed)
        remaining := counts
        for kind := removed[choice][]
            remaining[kind] -= 1
        for pattern := block_patterns(remaining, suited, &cache)[]
            sets := pattern[0] + extras[choice][0]
            pair := pattern[2] + extras[choice][2]
            if sets > 4 or pair > 1
                continue
            partial := pattern[1] + extras[choice][1]
            if partial > 4
                partial = 4
            slot := sets * 2 + pair
            if partial > best[slot]
                best[slot] = partial
    int[][] result := []
    for: slot < 10
        if best[slot] >= 0
            result = result.append([slot / 2, best[slot], slot % 2])
    .cache.set(key, result)
    return result

int standard_number(int[] counts, map<string, int[][]> &cache)
    int[][] states := [[0, 0, 0]]
    for: suit < 4
        stop := if suit == 3 then 34 else suit * 9 + 9
        patterns := block_patterns(counts[suit * 9:<stop], suit < 3, &cache)
        best := array(10, fill = -1)
        for prior := states[]
            for pattern := patterns[]
                sets := prior[0] + pattern[0]
                pair := prior[2] + pattern[2]
                if sets > 4 or pair > 1
                    continue
                partial := prior[1] + pattern[1]
                if partial > 4
                    partial = 4
                slot := sets * 2 + pair
                if partial > best[slot]
                    best[slot] = partial
        states = []
        for: slot < 10
            if best[slot] >= 0
                states = states.append([slot / 2, best[slot], slot % 2])
    result := 8
    for pattern := states[]
        partial := pattern[1]
        if partial > 4 - pattern[0]
            partial = 4 - pattern[0]
        candidate := 8 - 2 * pattern[0] - partial - pattern[2]
        if candidate < result
            result = candidate
    return result

int[] shanten_numbers(int[] counts, map<string, int[][]> &cache)
    pairs := 0
    kinds := 0
    orphan_kinds := 0
    orphan_pair := false
    for: kind < 34
        if counts[kind] > 0
            kinds += 1
            if tiles.is_yaochuu(kind)
                orphan_kinds += 1
        if counts[kind] >= 2
            pairs += 1
            if tiles.is_yaochuu(kind)
                orphan_pair = true
    missing := if kinds < 7 then 7 - kinds else 0
    return [standard_number(counts, &cache), 6 - pairs + missing, 13 - orphan_kinds - (if orphan_pair then 1 else 0)]

class Tile(int kind, bool red)
class Parsed(bool valid, Tile[] items)

Parsed parse_tiles(string text, allow_empty := false)
    Tile[] result := []
    if text == "-"
        return Parsed(allow_empty, result)
    int[] digits := []
    suits := "mpsz"
    for: i < int(#text)
        character := text[i]
        code := character.codepoints()[0]
        if code >= 48 and code <= 57
            digits = digits.append(int(character))
        else
            suit := -1
            for: j < 4
                if character == suits[j]
                    suit = j
            if suit < 0 or #digits == 0
                return Parsed(false, [])
            for digit := digits[]
                if suit == 3 and (digit < 1 or digit > 7)
                    return Parsed(false, [])
                number := if digit == 0 then 5 else digit
                result = result.append(Tile(suit * 9 + number - 1, digit == 0))
            digits = []
    return Parsed(#result > 0 and #digits == 0, result)

string kind_name(int kind)
    suits := "mpsz"
    return "{kind % 9 + 1}" + suits[kind / 9]

string block_name(int[] kinds)
    result := ""
    for kind := kinds.sorted()[]
        result += "{kind % 9 + 1}"
    suits := "mpsz"
    return result + suits[kinds[0] / 9]

int[] count_tiles(Tile[] items)
    result := array(34, fill = 0)
    for item := items[]
        result[item.kind] += 1
    return result

bool is_honor(int kind)
    return kind >= 27

bool is_terminal(int kind)
    return kind < 27 and (kind % 9 == 0 or kind % 9 == 8)

bool is_yaochuu(int kind)
    return is_honor(kind) or is_terminal(kind)

bool is_green(int kind)
    return kind == 19 or kind == 20 or kind == 21 or kind == 23 or kind == 25 or kind == 32

int[] orphans()
    return [0, 8, 9, 17, 18, 26, 27, 28, 29, 30, 31, 32, 33]

int next_indicator(int kind)
    if kind < 27
        return kind / 9 * 9 + (kind % 9 + 1) % 9
    if kind < 31
        return 27 + (kind - 26) % 4
    return 31 + (kind - 30) % 3

int wind_kind(string wind)
    winds := "ESWN"
    for: i < 4
        if wind == winds[i]
            return 27 + i
    return -1
